name: Kolkata
title: Kolkata: who is doing what about heat?
scope: Organisations and activities identified in public sources, read on 28 November 2026. It is not a complete list of everyone working on heat in Kolkata, and no organisation was contacted.

orientation.text: For Kolkata, the sources reviewed show more analysis than action: research on where heat is most severe and on lost water bodies and greenery, a state heat wave plan, and repeated calls for a city plan. No Kolkata Municipal Corporation heat action plan was found.

unknowns: Whether the city has used the assessment.
orgs.outside: Its Delhi analysis is counted on Delhi's profile.
orgs.name: Centre for Science and Environment
orgs.summary: Mapped heat zones across the municipal area and measured the loss of water bodies and vegetation.

authorities.name: Kolkata Municipal Corporation
authorities.role: The city corporation; the area of the heat zone assessment.

authorities.name: Disaster Management department, Government of West Bengal
authorities.role: Prepared the state Heat Wave Action Plan.

activities.title: Heat zone and land cover assessment
activities.desc: Maps of very severe and severe heat zones across the municipal area, and measures of lost water bodies and vegetation.

activities.evaluation: Not evaluated. A study of nine cities including Kolkata found most measures were seasonal or reactive.
activities.title: West Bengal Heat Wave Action Plan
activities.desc: The state plan that sets departmental duties in a heat wave.

timeline.text: After a hot April, scientists call for a city heat action plan.

gaps: Whether the Kolkata Municipal Corporation has a heat action plan; none was found.
Who in the city runs water points, shelters or health measures in a heat wave; no city-specific source was read.
Worker, community and health organisations working on heat in Kolkata; none was found in the sources reviewed, which says more about the search than the city.
Bengali-language sources were not searched systematically for this first version.

start_here.text: The heat zone assessment is a ready starting map.

method_note: Sources were found by web search in English; local-language sources were not searched systematically. Where a source could not be read, nothing rests on it.
